description: An attempt to emit a metric with a label value outside the declared bounded domain is rejected and replaced with a sentinel value or causes a validation error.
assertions: emission rejected because 'command' value is not in bounded domain
rejection logged with label_value and metric_name
no Prometheus metric emitted with unbounded label
sentinel value '_unknown' used if lenient mode active (strict mode: hard reject)
cardinality alarm NOT triggered by unbounded label reaching Prometheus
